items.title: Blue Jet Healthcare among 4 stocks flashing bullish signals, hinting at a possible uptrend
items.description: On July 29, four stocks in the Nifty500 appeared on the 'White Marubozu' bullish scanner, according to StockEdge's technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis that occurs when the opening price is the lowest for a given period, and the closing price is the highest.Represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and a small or nonexistent lower shadow, it indicates strong buying pressure throughout the session. Traders interpret it as a signal that buyers were in control from the opening to the closing, often using such patterns to assess the potential continuation of upward price momentum.

items.title: Kaynes Technology among 9 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
items.description: On July 29, nine stocks in the Nifty500 pack that gained over 5% were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from lower levels. “RSI trending up” indicates that Relative Strength Index (RSI) values are rising, suggesting strengthening momentum in the stock’s price action. This can indicate potential upward movement and is often used by traders to identify buying opportunities in momentum-driven markets.

items.title: Xtranet Technologies set for stock market debut today; GMP hints at 11% listing gains
items.description: Ahead of the listing, Xtranet Technologies is commanding a grey market premium (GMP) of around 11%, reflecting positive investor sentiment. Based on the IPO's upper price band of Rs 127 per share, the stock is expected to list at around Rs 142, translating into an estimated gain of nearly 11% over the issue price.

items.title: Stocks in news: Adani Ports, Adani Enterprises, Vedanta Oil & Gas, Asian Paints, 6 others
items.description: Indian stock indices Sensex and Nifty experienced a significant surge on Wednesday.  Several companies reported strong financial results for the June quarter.  Bajaj Housing Finance and MTAR Technologies showed substantial profit growth.  Vedanta Oil & Gas and Vedanta Iron and Steel returned to profitability.  Adani Enterprises, however, reported a net loss despite revenue increases.

items.title: Indo-MIM IPO set for market debut today; GMP signals up to 39% listing gain
items.description: The latest Grey Market Premium (GMP) stands at Rs 190, implying a premium of nearly 39% over the IPO's upper price band of Rs 485 per share. If current grey market trends hold, the stock could debut at around Rs 675 per share.

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 8 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: As of July 29, 2026, 18 Nifty 500 stocks closed above their 200-day moving average (DMA). Among them, we highlighted the top eight that gained more than 4%, based on StockEdge.com's technical scan data. The 200-day daily moving average (DMA) is used by traders as a key indicator for determining the overall trend in a particular stock. As long as the stock is priced above the 200-day SMA on the daily timeframe, it is generally considered to be in an overall uptrend. Take a look:"

items.title: Adani Ports Q1 net profit rises 10% on overseas growth
items.description: Adani Ports reported a 10.2% profit increase for the June quarter. Higher cargo volumes and international port business fueled this significant growth. Revenue from operations climbed 18.6 percent to ₹10,820.80 crore. The company's international ports business saw revenue surge eighty percent. Domestic ports revenue grew twelve percent as cargo volumes increased.

items.title: Adani Enterprises posts Q1 loss on US govt charge
items.description: Adani Enterprises reported a net loss of ₹1,160 crore for the June quarter. This loss was due to an exceptional charge related to an OFAC settlement. Strong growth in airports and roads businesses boosted operating performance significantly. The company reaffirmed its capital expenditure plans for upcoming fiscal years. Adani Enterprises has no current plans to enter the airline business.

items.title: Rupee rises for the third day to a near 3-week high
items.description: The rupee strengthened for a third consecutive day, reaching a near three-week high. Dollar sales by foreign and state-run banks aided the local currency's climb. Sustained buying in domestic equities and positive foreign investor sentiment supported the rupee. Crude oil prices saw a modest rebound, limiting further rupee gains. The currency is expected to trade within a specific range on Thursday.

items.title: Sensex, Nifty rally over 1% as IT stocks drive broad-based market gains
items.description: Indian stock gauges rose over one percent on Wednesday. Overseas fund flows are expected to shift into local technology companies. The Nifty and Sensex closed higher, reflecting positive investor sentiment. Declining crude oil prices and a stronger rupee also supported market gains. Foreign and domestic institutions were net buyers of shares.

items.title: D-St set for a muted opening as GIFT Nifty signals weak start
items.description: Indian equity markets opened yesterday with a strong gap-up and extended gains throughout the session.  The Indian Rupee appreciated from lower levels, boosting investor sentiment significantly.  Foreign portfolio investors were net buyers, adding to the positive market momentum.  Analysts suggest the index may head towards key resistance levels soon.  The India VIX, a fear gauge, also saw a notable decline.

items.title: These mid-cap stocks with ‘Strong Buy’ & ‘Buy’ recos can rally over 25%, according to analysts
items.description: The next time uncertainty over the firing of missiles in the Gulf region makes you anxious, remember this: It is not the first time that global markets have witnessed such phases. Similar scenarios have played out in the past; and at particular points of time, it had appeared that everything would crash and the world would come to an end. But the world is more resilient than we think. That said, the probability is high that we will see several such phases till the end of 2028. That is when the cause of much uncertainty will exit his office.

items.title: Motilal Oswal raises mid and smallcap allocation to 50%, stays neutral on Indian equities
items.description: Motilal Oswal Private Wealth favors Indian mid and small-cap stocks. They are increasing allocations to these segments by ten percentage points. The firm suggests a neutral stance on Indian equities overall. Hybrid and large-cap allocations are set at forty percent. Global equities will comprise the remaining ten percent of investments.

items.title: ProTec gets insurance licence; Irdai revamps key guidelines
items.description: ProTec General Insurance will be allowed to undertake general insurance business under the applicable regulatory framework. The four registrations granted so far in calendar 2026 include two general insurers, one health insurer and one reinsurer, Irdai said.

items.title: Axis, Kotak Mahindra raise charges for overseas card transactions
items.description: Axis Bank will increase the DCC fee on its credit cards to 3.5% from 1.5%, effective August 28, 2026, according to the bank's revised terms and conditions. Kotak Mahindra Bank will raise the fee on debit-card transactions to 3.5% plus goods and services tax (GST), from 1% plus GST, effective August 1.

items.title: FCNR(B) surge: Inflows through special window to ease banks’ liquidity pressure
items.description: In the first quarter of FY27, revised liquidity coverage ratio (LCR) norms came into effect, reducing the assumed run-off rate on deposits from non-financial entities such as trusts, limited liability partnerships (LLPs), and partnerships to 40% from 100% earlier. The change lowered projected 30-day cash outflows for banks, providing flexibility to the LCR mandate.

items.title: Dabur India shares fall 4% even as Q1 earnings meet estimates. What’s spooking investors?
items.description: Dabur India shares dropped over 4% on Thursday after reporting Q1 earnings. The company announced a 15% rise in net profit and 11% revenue growth. Brokerages noted steady performance, with home and personal care leading segment growth. Dabur expects double-digit revenue growth and improved margins for the fiscal year. Key monitorables include demand recovery, commodity inflation, and monsoon progress.

items.title: KPIT Technologies shares crash 7% after profit falls 32% to Rs 117 crore in Q1
items.description: KPIT Technologies shares tumbled 7% to Rs 592 on the BSE after posting a 32% YoY drop in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 117 crore. Operating margins contracted to 17.2% amid client pressures and guidance slowdowns, despite management expressing confidence in H2 recovery.

items.title: Pine Labs among 4 stocks that closed crossing below VWAP
items.description: On July 29, the closing prices of four Nifty500 stocks dropped over 1.5% relative to the VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price), and a shift below the VWAP suggests a potential bearish trend, according to stockedge.com's technical scan data.When the closing price falls below the VWAP, it signifies that the closing price is lower than the average price at which it was traded throughout the day, with the average being weighted by trading volume. This can indicate increased selling pressure.

items.title: Thangamayil Jewellery shares crash 19% in 2 days on weak Q2 outlook. What did the company say?
items.description: Thangamayil Jewellery shares hit the lower circuit, extending losses to 19% in two sessions after the company warned of a weak Q2 FY27. The jeweller said sales showed no visible improvement in the first 28 days of the quarter due to geopolitical uncertainty and customers delaying purchases amid expectations of lower gold prices.

items.title: Waaree Energies shares slide 6% despite 15% profit growth and 79% YoY revenue surge in Q1FY27
items.description: Shares of Waaree Energies fell nearly 6% to Rs 2,581.70 despite posting a strong Q1FY27 performance. Consolidated net profit rose 15.39% YoY to Rs 891.87 crore, while revenue jumped 79.22% to Rs 7,931.79 crore. A record order book of Rs 61,500 crore continues to bolster future visibility.

items.title: Multibagger MTAR Tech rallies 5% after 12% slide in 4 days. Here are 2 triggers
items.description: MTAR Technologies saw a significant profit jump and revenue surge in the first quarter. The company's EBITDA nearly tripled, reflecting strong operational performance and growth. MTAR Technologies secured its largest civil nuclear order, enhancing future visibility. An existing customer amended a purchase order, increasing its total value substantially. The company is well-positioned for future growth across its business verticals.

items.title: Buy, Sell or Hold: Morgan Stanley maintains an Equal-Weight on Eicher Motors; Citi recommends sell on Colgate-Palmolive
items.description: Brokerages remained divided on Asian Paints, Colgate-Palmolive India and Eicher Motors after their Q1FY27 earnings. Goldman Sachs and Citi retained 'Sell' calls despite strong quarterly numbers, while Morgan Stanley maintained an 'Equal-Weight' rating on Eicher Motors after the Royal Enfield maker posted an earnings beat led by robust domestic demand.

items.title: Redington shares rally 15% after Q1 profit surges 77%; revenue rises 35% YoY
items.description: Redington Ltd shares surged after the company reported a strong Q1 FY27 performance, with net profit jumping 77% YoY to Rs 486 crore on record revenue and broad-based growth across segments. Excluding exceptional items, PAT grew more than twice the pace of revenue, indicating strong operating leverage.

items.title: Eicher Motors share price target: What are Morgan Stanley, Nomura saying about Royal Enfield maker?
items.description: Eicher Motors shares remained flat on Thursday following a 21% YoY rise in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 1,462 crore, backed by record Royal Enfield sales. International brokerages Nomura, Morgan Stanley, and Nuvama issued mixed ratings, setting target prices between Rs 7,763 and Rs 8,900 for the motorcycle maker.

items.title: Asian Paints shares decline 3% after Q1 results. Should you buy, sell or hold?
items.description: Asian Paints shares fell 3% despite better-than-expected Q1 FY27 earnings and multiple target price hikes by brokerages. Nomura retained its Buy rating with a Street-high target of Rs 3,750, citing strong demand and easing competitive pressures. Goldman Sachs maintained Sell, while Motilal Oswal stayed Neutral, highlighting margin resilience despite inflationary pressures and stiff competition.

items.title: Vedanta Oil & Gas shares dip 4% despite becoming profitable in Q1
items.description: Vedanta Oil & Gas shares fell despite the company reporting a sharp turnaround in Q1 FY27, posting a consolidated net profit of Rs 945 crore against losses in both the year-ago and previous quarters. Revenue rose 8.5% YoY to Rs 2,507 crore, even as the company recorded an exceptional loss of Rs 441 crore during the quarter.

items.title: F&O Radar: Call Ratio Spread strategy for Aurobindo Pharma this week
items.description: AUROPHARMA shows a strong bullish technical structure and trades near Rs 1,590. The stock maintains a higher high-higher low formation, indicating sustained buying interest. Momentum indicators and Supertrend confirm a positive outlook for the stock. Derivatives data reflects a positive undertone with supportive put writing. A bullish call ratio spread strategy is recommended for potential upside.

items.title: Odyssey of stock market: What investors can learn from the Greek epic hero’s journey back home?
items.description: Investors can learn from Odysseus's long voyage home.  Resisting temptations and instant profits are crucial for long-term success.  True value in stocks is revealed over extended periods of time.  Stagnation in risk-free assets hinders portfolio growth and ultimate goals.  Patience and adaptability are key for survival and achieving investment objectives.

items.title: Adani Ports shares shed 3% after Q1 results. Here's why Nomura and other brokerages see up to 24% upside
items.description: Adani Ports shares fell 3% after the company reported Q1 FY27 results. Net profit rose 9% year-on-year to Rs 3,620 crore, while revenue increased 18.5% to Rs 10,821 crore. EBITDA grew 19% to Rs 6,540 crore, with the margin improving marginally to 60.4%. Despite the earnings growth, the stock came under selling pressure in Thursday's trade.

items.title: Sensex, Nifty trade flat as hawkish Fed pause dents sentiment. What's driving the caution?
items.description: Indian stock markets traded flat on Thursday. The US Federal Reserve kept key interest rates unchanged. Policymakers indicated a potential rate hike later this year. Sensex and Nifty 50 saw slight gains after opening lower. Broader markets, however, remained in negative territory.

items.title: Global chip rout: How should investors play India's AI trade that gave up to 400% returns this year?
items.description: Global AI stocks face a sharp selloff, impacting Indian investor strategies.  Indian markets focus on infrastructure like data centers and power equipment.  Analysts suggest a balanced approach, avoiding panic exits from AI-linked trades.  Investors should prioritize quality companies with strong fundamentals and clear execution.  Valuation resets offer opportunities for disciplined, long-term investment in the AI theme.

items.title: SML Mahindra shares rally over 18% on acquisition of M&M’s truck division. What it means for shareholders?
items.description: SML Mahindra shares surged on Thursday after the company announced the Rs 525 crore acquisition of Mahindra & Mahindra's Truck and Bus Division. Analysts view the deal positively, citing stronger market positioning, operational synergies and long-term earnings accretion, though some near-term margin dilution could persist after the business integration.

items.title: Indo-MIM shares list at 45% premium. Should investors book profits or stay invested?
items.description: Indo-MIM shares debuted at nearly a 45% premium over the IPO price, delivering strong listing gains to investors. While experts remain positive about the company's long-term growth prospects, they recommend partial profit-booking after the sharp rally, citing rich valuations and the possibility of near-term consolidation.

items.title: Madhusudan Kela-backed Singularity Equity Fund picks stake in this smallcap stock via block deal worth Rs 12 crore
items.description: Madhusudan Kela-led Singularity Equity Fund I acquired 5.27 lakh shares of TIL through a bulk deal worth Rs 11.78 crore. The PMS fund bought the shares at an average price of Rs 223.72 apiece, around 15% below the stock’s closing price of Rs 262.48 on Wednesday.
